description: This file defines interfaces for the xdiff library, including callback types, constants, and function prototypes related to diff processing, file comparison, and configuration handling.

methods.name: xdi_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff between two memory-mapped files using specified parameters and callbacks.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Generates a diff output between two memory-mapped files, invoking provided callback functions for hunks and lines.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into a memory-mapped file structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads data identified by object ID into a memory-mapped file structure.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Determines if the given buffer likely contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets a find function for diff configuration.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears the current find function in diff configuration.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses and returns a style type from a string.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Configures merge behavior based on variables and values.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two strings of specified lengths, considering whitespace flags.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Computes a hash of the given string with whitespace handling flags.

ctags.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(void * data,long old_begin,long old_nr,long new_begin,long new_nr,const char * func,long funclen)
